title: P104: prove a rank-four source-preconditioning obstruction
body:
I prove that any invertible scalar source preconditioner completing the fixed P104 channel through the retained pooled monotone correction model must satisfy `rank(U-I)>=4`. I compress a whole dependency path to one virtual helper in the complete endpoint pool, then exhibit an unreachable 4-by-4 block of `G/2` with determinant `1/16`. This extends PR3252/3259's dependency-path arguments to the changed source-preconditioning contract.

I also verify a one-H2 source shear that removes PR3259's older single-entry cut. The stronger support certificate excludes its required correction. For the implementation class charging one H2 per rank-one update, four charges exceed the retained optimistic selected-budget screen: moment `[1.000088868784313991, 1.000088868784313992]`. I stop that separate-shear construction route. Rank four alone gives no tariff for a joint native preparation.

Evidence:

- Two support methods agree on all 416 entries for four source columns; rational elimination and an integer permutation sum give the same determinant.
- Exact native bridge checks cover all 512 basis columns and tensor depths 1,2,3. I replay the 4,058-event channel over all 280 independent inputs and reject four boundary corruptions.
- The registered Python 3.12 replay passes all three commands with `-I -O -Werror -B`. Committed-byte and declared-history checks pass for head `344774ba08a73fc3a85fdcb93fb319927bde3ea2` and 24 files.
- I confirmed [hosted CI success](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39086823041): planning, clean-checkout replay and the unchanged-input check pass.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-source-preconditioning
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-source-preconditioning --check-source-history
```

I retain fixed X/Y frame paths, independent helper dirt, unread targets, monotone flags, equal-frame transfers and no extra correlated storage after preparation. I relax chronology and pool 2,309 endpoint pairs. I claim no complete correction, new supplier, kappa improvement, independent human review or formal verification. Joint preparation, changed covers/access and complete consumer costs remain open.

I start from canonical main `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`; the submission fetch retains that head and priority revision 6. I checked cached fully paginated PR/Discussion coverage plus a fresh delta and the canonical thread. See [claim and findings](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-19008886) and package metadata for scope and limitations.

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance including mathematical source-analysis agents. I retain dcharb78, Nick Petalas, commdata2338, Ross Richardson, Cinna Davis, ywz65, Arham Tahir, Hiroki Kumazaki, Douglas Colkitt and the PR1972/1991 geometry/native/compiler lineage in the package attribution. I leave predecessor packages and the selected frontier unchanged.
